phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Capacitive soil moisture sensor probe integrated with a microcontroller unit (MCU) and a wireless radio communication module, designed for real-time measurement and remote telemetry of soil moisture levels in agricultural applications.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: This specification reflects the industry-standard integration of a capacitive sensing element combined with on-board signal processing (MCU) and wireless transmission (radio) to enable smart, IoT-enabled soil monitoring, which is the dominant form adopted in modern precision agriculture due to ease of deployment and remote data accessibility.
